gates.requirement: Preparation freezes the exact corpus rights, acquisition and calibration scope, checkpoints, code, models, licenses, tasks, exclusions, failure rules, estimands, execution packet, treatment materials, grammar, protocol inputs, and safety flags.
The corpus must be rights-cleared and content-addressed before a preparation record can be created.
Digital reference calibration is required; unavailable physical calibration remains explicit and cannot be upgraded by a synthetic fixture.

Meaningful and equivalence bounds, coverage and effect tolerances, capacities, unmatched penalty, perturbations, treatments, leakage checks, uncertainty, multiplicity, and power assumptions are frozen before the method pilot.
Method-pilot evidence binds the exact frozen-parameter digest and records feasibility only.
Preparation and pilot inputs prohibit confirmatory tests, held-out outcome access, human data, and listener data.
Invalid rights, unsafe flags, incomplete feasibility, leakage failure, or a parameter-digest mismatch creates a durable refusal or failure receipt without a research artifact.

The capability account keeps confirmatory machine study and integrated analysis unavailable, human protocol submission authorization-required, and human collection and public research projection prohibited.
Conformance runs locally with synthetic fixtures and performs no network access, playback, external model or engine execution, participant interaction, or public research projection.
Actual research plans, audits, evidence packets, and phase-control documents remain outside the tracked public repository.
